text:
matt: Quick heads-up — our latest SDK publish is confusing both editors and edge runtimes. Cloudflare Worker sample throws 'Unexpected token export' and VSCode can't find types. Anyone seen this pattern?

sophia: Did you rely solely on conditional exports for types? Some toolchains still need a top-level "types" field.

matt: We put types only in exports like `".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js" }`. No root-level types.

ivan: That explains editor complaints. Also note some bundlers (and Bun/Vite) don't fully support conditional exports and may fall back to the cjs path, which will break ESM-only runtimes.

matt: Runtime trace in worker: `TypeError: Unexpected token 'export' at file:///app/dist/esm/utils.mjs:1:1`. Looks like a CJS loader tried to parse ESM or vice-versa.

tara: Another symptom we saw: auth retry and token refresh behave differently depending on build. Node bundling runs the middleware chain; the edge bundle ends up using a minimal fetch path and the retry/refresh isn't invoked. App surfaces auth failure instead of refresh+retry.

sophia: Short-term patch: add root-level `"types": "dist/index.d.ts"` and ensure `exports["."].types` is present. Also consider adding `module` and `main` fields for older bundlers.

ivan: Medium-term: publish an explicit edge subpath in exports, e.g. `"./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" }` and have CI smoke-install the tarball into the edge sample so we catch packaging regressions.

matt: For retry mismatch, propose adding a tiny adapter API: `createRequester({ fetchImpl?, retryHook? })` or allow `new RedwoodClient({ fetch: globalThis.fetch, retryHandler })` so edge apps can pass their runtime fetch and still get auth refresh logic. Keep Node defaults unchanged.

tara: Agreed. Also document recommended bundler config: esbuild `format: 'esm'`, `platform: 'browser'`, `target: 'es2022'`, `bundle: true` to avoid accidental require() emissions.

cli-bot: publish-check: npm pack -> install -> run edge-smoke: FAILED — missing top-level types, edge entry not explicit.

sophia: I'll open a patch that adds root `types`, explicit `exports["."].types`, and an `./edge` conditional export that points to a dedicated ESM build. Also add a changelog note about the new `fetch`/`retry` optional config.

matt: Thanks — will hold the sample-app PR until patch is published so CI can validate the tarball. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
